issues.on_page: Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Modified Cash Basis - Governmental Funds
issues.issue: The governmental funds are on a modified cash basis, but the extraction records them as GAAP so that fund balance rolls forward. That's defensible, but the report isn't GAAP. Related: ending_cash (-69,774) is only the Cash and cash equivalents line from the p4 balance sheet. It leaves out Certificates of deposit 12,687, Restricted cash 683,539 and County treasurer cash 13,521 (total assets 639,973).

The line mixes private gifts with grants. The Statement of Activities (pp2-3) shows 190,387 operating grants and 64,548 capital grants (Economic Development). The Recycling 15,761 and Fire 20,611 amounts may be government grants, which would be intergovernmental. The source isn't stated. Same issue in detail (Economic Development 64,548, Recycling 15,761).
Repayments of Community Betterment Fund loans. No category fits exactly, so 'other' is defensible. Review flag set.

Both departments were set to streets/highways so the function split ties to the statement's Public works line (16,542 = 15,330 + 1,212, which checks). The category rules would otherwise put cemetery under health/welfare and recycling under utilities. Only the first Cemetery line has a review flag.
'Salaries and benefits' combines wages and benefits and is recorded as salaries and wages. 'Transportation' is assumed to be fuel. Both are judgment calls.
